shared_elements: low-relief carving on a stone slab
justification: Both surfaces show low-relief profile quadrupeds organised in roughly horizontal bands, which is about as generic as figural relief gets. A depicts only schematic, flat, repeated animals and abstract elements with no humans or objects, while B shows a narrative battle scene with naturalistic modelled human figures, chariots with spoked wheels, horses and weapons — an entirely different subject and level of naturalism.
